state: Frozen from public contract only before original fixture/PDF or candidate implementation intake
scope: Independent receiving of original PDFs produced by root's actual TasteTable CLI/offline Chrome print flow. No candidate-source review, report generation, browser replay, comparator or print-output regeneration.
prerequisites: Receive frozen root fixtures before original PDFs where possible; independently derive literal occurrence, note and provenance expectations from original source records and the public contract.
Admit exact original input/HTML/PDF bytes and root process/browser print record. A transport copy remains original only when byte-identical to its pinned PDF.
Reuse only the already qualified Poppler route after exact executable identity/hash and current capacity admission. No install, policy, identity or source changes.
All decoding/rasterization writes remain in a new own receiving directory. Preserve the original PDFs and rehash them after inspection.

checks.name: original_custody
checks.expect: Every supplied original input, generated HTML and original PDF matches the offered manifest before and after independent reading. Retain raw pdfinfo, pdftotext and raster tool stdout/stderr/exit records.

checks.name: occurrence_completeness
checks.expect: Every original pick has one visible occurrence section in source order, including repeated venue IDs, omitted/unrecorded visits and any kept-off-week occurrence. Account for occurrence keys independently of duplicated venue names.

checks.name: field_fidelity
checks.expect: Visible occurrence text accounts for literal venue/entity/kind, original/planned day/date or explicit kept-off-week, raw outcome plus correct label, actual date or Not recorded, full exact note content or No note recorded, and original explanation. Do not infer absent dates/outcomes.

checks.name: provenance
checks.expect: Record filename, raw-record SHA when supplied, source filename, week start, source receivedAt/source savedAt/record savedAt and mock/live/unknown saved-provenance label remain visible with backup/report limitation.

checks.name: long_content
checks.expect: Long notes may span pages without missing start/interior/end text. Count independently selected unique tokens and repeated-token multiplicities, and inspect each original page raster so extraction alone cannot certify visible unclipped content.

checks.name: geometry
checks.expect: Decode original page count/sizes, receive bounding boxes from original PDF text, identify clipped/out-of-page content or blank/missing sections, and inspect page images at declared resolution. A raster is a decode of the original PDF, not a new print.

checks.name: literal_content
checks.expect: Treat hostile-looking markup/URLs as literal source strings; check visible literal content rather than interpreting it. Root owns actual HTML/network/CSP checks; no duplicate browser gate is inferred from PDF.

limits: PDF extraction can reorder text or normalize CR, LF, TAB, multiple spaces and page-break whitespace. It cannot alone prove exact DOM whitespace identity, even when all visible words are preserved.

Do not apply Unicode compatibility normalization or fuzzy matching that erases distinct literal IDs. Record any extraction limitation explicitly and consult original page images and root DOM evidence.
Visible glyph rendering and complete word accounting are distinct from lossless editable backup. The PDF/report is not the original saved visit record.
This receiver does not qualify model/CLI refusal races, full inherited suites, source integration or deployment.
Any missing runtime/fixture/actual-print evidence leaves the corresponding receiving gate pending rather than inventing a pass.
sensitivity: Where suitable, challenge the independent accounting against in-memory removed or reordered expected content; do not mutate original PDFs or product outputs.
